summary.text: Matthew Overcast is a Republican state representative who has represented Missouri House District 155 since 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Overcast is an attorney and U.S. Air Force veteran.

paragraphs.text: Matthew Overcast was born in Houston, Missouri, served in the U.S. Air Force from 2010 to 2014, and graduated from Ava High School.
He earned an associate degree in legal studies and a bachelor's degree in criminal justice from Drury University, and a law degree from the Mitchell Hamline School of Law.
His career experience includes working as an attorney, probation officer and law clerk, and in 2024 he started his own law practice specializing in business and education law.
Overcast took office on January 8, 2025, succeeding Travis Smith.
For 2025-2026 Ballotpedia lists him on the Judiciary, Elementary and Secondary Education and Emerging Issues committees and two joint committees.
